name: mirage
text: Version 1.0.77 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.77 . It changes only the engine, so you don't need to install anything. The engine runs the fix now, after its restart. Its first list is still filling, since a cold start has no earlier list to keep. After that the +EV list should stop emptying at each scan start. I'm checking GitHub's published list for the next few minutes to confirm it stays populated. If you still see bets vanish after about 10 minutes, tell me.
